title: MoT3DVG: A Benchmark for Outdoor 3D Visual Grounding with Motion-Aware Descriptions and Temporal Cues
abstract: arXiv:2611.11334v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: 3D visual grounding (3DVG) localizes language-referred objects in 3D scenes, with broad applicability in both indoor and outdoor environments. However, existing 3DVG research focuses on static indoor objects, limiting its use in dynamic outdoor autonomous driving. Motion descriptions, which capture the temporal dynamics of moving objects, offer a promising way to address this challenge. We therefore introduce MoT3DVG, a large-scale dataset for dynamic-aware outdoor 3DVG with temporally evolving motion descriptions. It contains 850 scenarios with 31,128 frames from nuScenes dataset, and provides 144,568 language prompts with motion-aware descriptions for dynamic objects across time. We further propose DynaVG, a novel framework that effectively leverages temporal cues for outdoor 3DVG. translated_title: MoT3DVG：一个具有运动感知描述与时间线索的室外3D视觉定位基准
translated_abstract: 3D视觉定位（3DVG）旨在3D场景中定位语言所指的对象，在室内和室外环境中都具有广泛的适用性。然而，现有的3DVG研究主要集中在静态室内对象上，限制了其在动态室外自动驾驶场景中的应用。运动描述能够捕捉运动对象的时间动态特性，为解决这一挑战提供了一种有前景的方法。因此，我们提出了MoT3DVG，一个面向动态感知室外3D视觉定位的大规模数据集，包含随时间演变的运动描述。该数据集包含来自nuScenes数据集的850个场景和31,128帧数据，并提供了144,568条带有动态对象跨时间运动感知描述的语言提示。我们进一步提出了DynaVG，一种有效利用时间线索进行室外3D视觉定位的新型框架。除了标准的模态特定编码器外，DynaVG还在语言之前引入了短-长集成动态编码（SLIDE）模块……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个面向动态室外场景的3D视觉定位大规模基准MoT3DVG（含850个场景、14万余条带时间演化运动描述的语言提示），并设计了利用时间线索的新型框架DynaVG以实现室外3D视觉定位。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MoT3DVG, the first large-scale benchmark for dynamic outdoor 3D visual grounding with temporally evolving motion-aware descriptions, and proposes DynaVG, a novel framework that effectively leverages temporal cues for outdoor 3DVG.
